title: Besatheus
description: Besatheus is a world where civilization has risen and fallen many times, the remains of once great cities litter the land, great statues and towering buildings lie in ruins, and ancient war machines rest on the abandoned battlefields. In this ever-changing and vibrant world the Clans engage in an age old battle of magic and science; where the weak cling to the vestiges of once great civilizations and fight for power over the scraps. The world draws near an end, a great evil has arisen, and heroes must rise to protect what is left and restore the glory of a once great people.

cardPool.title: Shaman
cardPool.value: Shamans are the religious leaders of the people of Besatheus. Summoning powerful elemental beings as their allies, they can channel the power of the elements to rid the world of evil. Their abilities are great in number and range from single target attacks to wide area of effect damage spells.

cardPool.title: Tinkerer
cardPool.value: Tinkerers are an odd lot, more often than not they are the last of their clan. Tinkerers are often extremely smart, but often also very naïve. Their knowledge and skill in technology far surpasses any other profession, and their eccentricities often make lasting friendships with other professions difficult.

cardPool.title: Scout
cardPool.value: Scouts are the most agile members of the clan armies. They move quickly across the battlefield, reporting the positioning and activities of the enemy to the commanders. Scouts are masters of evasion, and are able to avoid many attacks that would otherwise spell their instant demise. Their mastery of the stealth arts enables them to cross the toughest of areas undetected and spy on their enemies. Scouts are masters of stealth and ranged combat, combining these tools into a lethal skill few can match.

cardPool.title: Knights
cardPool.value: Knights are the protectors of the peace. They establish a foundation for civilization to flourish and the clan to prosper. Sworn to uphold the law and protect the innocent, they are the ruthless balance between good and evil.

cardPool.title: Elf
cardPool.value: Elves are a proud race, full of a sense of nobility and selflessness. Although they are physically weak, they can create powerful magic arts that manifest as physical armor. Elves were once the most dominant race in all of Besatheus, but after civilization fell, and their creators abandoned them, they were forced to live within the shell of a once great city. Eventually, the elves regained control of the city, but these days their pride is keeping them from exploring and rebuilding the rest of the world. Elves will help anyone in need, but they never take sides in any conflict, except for those that threaten their new friend's well-being.

cardPool.title: Half-Elf
cardPool.value: The Half-Elf are the offspring of humans and elves. As an intelligent race, they live in the cities, where they make up leaders and government officials. They are a curious people, very adaptable to new environments. They love to travel and explore and are more at home in the wilderness than in any city. The Half-Elf are an attractive people, taller than humans on average, with fair skin, and often with pointed ears. They make quick friends and are loyal to the end.

Their advanced understanding of combat and their utter disregard for it, has made them an unpredictable bunch. Their keenly developed sense of honor has created warriors who would rather fall to their foes than succumb to defeat.

They are a bulky, heavily armored race, capable of absorbing immense amounts of damage. Their armor can take on the physical appearance of the wearer's own clothing, which allows them a measure of personalization.

cardPool.value: Ravia is the capital of the Kingdom of Zalanthas. It is a bustling city and the center of political intrigue. It is filled with fine shops and gathering places for the elite of the city. The city is split between the lavish estates of the rich and the poor tents of the commoners.

cardPool.title: Higba
cardPool.value: Higba is a dangerous mining town in the kingdom of Zalanthas. It is filled with many miners looking to dig up gems and precious metals from the dangerous tunnels under the town and the surrounding peaks. The town has recently had a resurgence in bandit activity forcing the nearby military to keep a constant watch over the town. Despite this recent crime the people of Higba are happy and work well together. They've become a shining example of how the citizens of Zalanthas are meant to live.

Although there have been numerous attempts to industrialize the town, the production of wool is still the primary industry. Many nomadic traders visit the town, traveling from the city of Kalksdemnos to the north. It is said that the red moon that sometimes hovers over the town at night is the sign of a lost city buried beneath the hills.

She reminds her people that they have endured the darkness and should not believe that the light will always persist.

cardPool.title: Confederation of the Clans
cardPool.value: The Confederation of the Clans is an alliance of the nomadic clans of Besatheus. Originally an alliance of convenience, the clans have banded together under the leadership of the Clan of the Bear and the Clan of the Raven to conquer and unite the world. The Confederation is a land of ancient ruins and war machines. The people of the Confederation believe that the rise of their people and the dawn of their golden age is destined and ordained by their gods.

cardPool.title: Okenar
cardPool.value: The kingdom of Okenar rests in the midst of the once great empire of Zennoj. An ancient race known as the Elves once populated the land but their civilization crumbled long ago. The remnants of a castle can be found here, but the beauty of the once lost race has faded into stories. The current rulers of the kingdom are the humans of the Okenar clan. This new sub-race of humans is half elf and half human. They have inherited the keen eyesight of their elven ancestors, and the tenacious nature of the humans who first settled this land.

cardPool.title: Dragonborn
cardPool.value: A Dragonborn is a human-dragon hybrid, or half-dragon. Although some folk used to call them half-breeds, they prefer to be known as half-dragons. Either way, they are a tough race to understand. They are the product of powerful and ancient dragons who mated with human females, and the gene is only passed on to a rarely chosen few. These half-dragon progeny are more human than dragon; but where their human side is average, they possess the fierce intellect, thirst for knowledge, and formidable combat prowess of their dragon parents.

Pilots are the most valuable members of their clan, a duocraft is only as good as the pilot controlling it.
